proposal.hypothesis: Four independent scalar minimum/index chains may reduce loop-carried dependence relative to the single-chain scan. A final signed-value, lowest-index fold preserves argmin semantics; measurements are needed to determine whether this helps on random and decreasing inputs.

retained: Unrolled the scalar scan by four using four independent minimum-value and index accumulators.
Used strict per-accumulator updates to retain each lane's earliest index, then folded with signed-value and lowest-index ordering.
Handled inputs smaller than four scalarly and processed any remaining elements scalarly after the fold.
